name: Camino | 200mg Fruit Chews | Boysenberry (2:1 THC:CBN)
description: Take a nighttime stroll under the hypnotic glow of the Northern Lights and wind down with Boysenberry 'Sleep' Camino Chews. This delicious chew features a potent indica-like blend of 10mg THC and 5mg CBN with chamomile and lavender extracts plus these plant-based terpenes: Beta-Caryophyllene, Linalool, Myrcene.
